output.summary: A tree native to South America, including central Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay and Peru. It has a short trunk and rounded crown; its seedpods contain a sweet floury paste used for human flour and, in the 1940s, a fermented mildly intoxicating drink.
output.edibilityNote: The sweet fruit paste is made into flour for human consumption and was fermented into an alcoholic drink in the 1940s.
